body.prompt: Close-up inside a dark leather Roman command tent on the Danube at night, an iron brazier glowing orange, deep blue shadow by a small oil lamp: a woman's hand with a gold bracelet writing with a reed pen on a sheet of papyrus, only blurred dark smudges of ink with nothing readable.
